pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: centre pivot of the sliding pedals (rudder)

pedals.axis.brake_left.name: Left toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_left.note: left pedal toe plate (left toe brake)

pedals.axis.brake_right.name: Right toe brake
pedals.axis.brake_right.note: right pedal toe plate (right toe brake)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), seen from the pilot's seat: heel rest nearest the camera, left pedal on the left, right pedal on the right
mappingSource: catalog (thrustmaster.json): standalone on USB via the T.RJ12 adapter X = right toe brake, Y = left toe brake, Z = rudder per FlightGear T-Rudder.xml (https://gitlab.com/flightgear/fgdata/-/blob/next/Input/Joysticks/ThrustMaster/T-Rudder.xml); the vendor TCA Yoke Pack sheet (https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/pictures/Mappings/MappingTCAyokePack_PC.PDF p.1: Axis X right brake, Axis Y left brake, Axis Z rudder) agrees; TFRP user manual https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/accessories/Manuals/TFRP/TFRP_User_Manual.pdf
note: The axis letters apply standalone; plugged into a TWCS/T.Flight/TCA host the axes merge into that device with the host's letters (catalog note). The catalog records a doubt (EDRefCard lists X = left, Y = right for T-Rudder); the vendor sheet sides with the catalog, but it shows the pedals merged into the TCA yoke, so mapping stays medium.
